name: bg_beneficial_owners
description: A Bulgarian legal entity's beneficial owners (Registry Agency, Commercial Register and Register of Non-Profit Legal Entities) by its EIK/UIC (the 9-digit, or 13-digit for a foreign-company branch, unified identification code). Each owner's name, the country the register names for them, country of residence when the register states one, and the register's OWN free-text description of their manner of control -- this may be a true beneficial owner or the AMLD fallback category (a senior managing official recorded when no other beneficial owner can be established), and the description says which. Returns found:true with an empty owner list when the entity's record carries no natural-person owners on file (common for entities whose ownership chain resolves only through other companies). Anyone named here can request removal at support@pipeworx.io; a removal already on file is silently withheld and counted in withheld_by_removal_request.

eik.description: Bulgarian EIK/UIC, 9 digits (13 for a foreign-company branch), e.g. "130007884".
